notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p]Reduced the amount of Stamina drain when falling into the water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where NPCs would become invisible, resulting in controls becoming unresponsive[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when moving barn animals between the barn and the pasture, resulting in an occasional game crash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug in pet training with extended delay between commands showing on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug occurring while holding an item, then catching a bug/critter and reaching 0 Stamina, resulting in an occasional progress blocker[/p][/*][/list]

tags.balance_change: Reduced the amount of Stamina drain when falling into the water

tags.bug: Fixed bug where NPCs would become invisible, resulting in controls becoming unresponsive
Fixed bug when moving barn animals between the barn and the pasture, resulting in an occasional game crash
Fixed bug in pet training with extended delay between commands showing on screen
Fixed bug occurring while holding an item, then catching a bug/critter and reaching 0 Stamina, resulting in an occasional progress blocker

notes.title: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Editions Detailed
notes.content:
The winds of change start with you! [i]STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar[/i] is coming soon, and this latest trailer showcases even more of the wholesome adventures waiting for you in Zephyr Town. 

[previewyoutube=tHNfuL8EhL0;full]https://youtu.be/tHNfuL8EhL0[/previewyoutube]

Along with this new trailer, we’ve also got details about what’s included in the digital editions that will be available at launch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558636/8b25d7b73b29d4ab6b24644455b6c0ea1848cfa5.jpg[/img]
[b]STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Standard Edition ($49.99): [/b]
[list][*] STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar base game 
[*] “Cow Set” cosmetic DLC: Cow Costume, Cow Headwear, Cow Glider [/list]
[b]STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Deluxe Edition ($59.98): [/b]
[list][*] STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar base game 
[*] “Cow Set” cosmetic DLC: Cow Costume, Cow Headwear, Cow Glider 
[*] “Trunk of Transformation” cosmetic DLC: Chick Costume (Yellow), Chick Headwear (Yellow), Chick Costume (Black), Chick Headwear (Black), Alpaca Costume (White), Alpaca Headwear (White), Alpaca Costume (Brown), Alpaca Headwear (Brown), Ninja Outfit, Ninja Glider, Ninja Bazaar Set, Braid & Flowers, Cat Ear Buns with Highlights, Short Perm, Side Part with Highlights [/list]
[b]STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Super Digital Deluxe Edition ($69.98): [/b]
[list][*] Includes the contents of the Digital Deluxe Edition, plus: 
[*] STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital soundtrack 
[*] STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital art book [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558636/ff44fb853fb4b7e06cfbdffd0569d0043dd1ea42.jpg[/img]
[b]STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar “Trunk of Transformation Bundle” DLC ($9.99):[/b] 
[list][*] “Trunk of Transformation” cosmetic DLC: Chick Costume (Yellow), Chick Headwear (Yellow), Chick Costume (Black), Chick Headwear (Black), Alpaca Costume (White), Alpaca Headwear (White), Alpaca Costume (Brown), Alpaca Headwear (Brown), Ninja Outfit, Ninja Glider, Ninja Bazaar Set, Braid & Flowers, Cat Ear Buns with Highlights, Short Perm, Side Part with Highlights [/list]
[b]STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar “Super Digital Deluxe DLC” Set ($19.99): [/b]
[list][*] Includes the “Trunk of Transformation Bundle” DLC, plus: 
[*] STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital soundtrack 
[*] STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital art book [/list]

Wishlist now and prepare to set up shop for your new life, when [i]STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar[/i] arrives on August 27!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508780/STORY_OF_SEASONS_Grand_Bazaar
